problem-solving-process-story.text: You Have All the Pieces. AJ, Nia, and Malik step into the final week with the whole toolbox ready: deep questions, sharp data sense, and real building skills. Now they are putting it all together to solve a real problem.
Start with Questions. Every solution starts with understanding. Nia pushes the crew to go six levels deep so they understand the real problem instead of jumping at the first answer.
Gather Data. Malik goes hunting for useful information. What resources exist? What do people say? What specific data would help? The crew organizes what they find and starts looking for patterns.

Find Insights. Patterns in the data reveal opportunities, and AJ is the one who spots what the numbers and notes are really saying. What's missing? What could be better? Insight turns the pile into direction.
Build the Solution. Now the crew builds. They use Cursor and AI to create something that addresses the problem, then they test it, improve it, and keep the solution moving like a living story.

capstone-journey-story.text: Choose Your Problem. AJ picks one problem to solve, and the rule stays the same: it has to be real, specific, and something the crew can actually address with a tool or resource.
Deep Understanding. Nia keeps asking why about each answer until the crew reaches the root. They document all six levels because the deeper the understanding, the better the solution.

Gather Your Data. Malik gathers the data with a curious eye for detail. What resources or solutions already exist? What do people say? What specific data would help? Then the crew organizes everything they find.
Build with AI. AJ describes what he wants, explains the problem, and names the features. Cursor helps turn that direction into a polished solution, then the crew iterates based on what works.
Deploy and Test. The crew puts the solution on GitHub Pages so it is live on the internet. They share it with a few real people, listen to the feedback, and make the next version stronger.

portfolio-celebration-story.text: Your Portfolio. The portfolio is the crew's proof. It shows everything they learned across the weeks plus the capstone project, and it says they can solve real problems now.

Present Your Work. AJ presents the capstone to the group while Nia keeps the story tight and Malik calls out the technical wins. They cover the problem, the research, the data, the demo, and what they learned in three to five minutes.
Show, Don't Tell. They demo the actual project and let everybody see it work. Quality over quantity. The crew knows they built something real, and that is worth showing.
You're a Builder Now. Nia says it plain: the crew is not just consuming technology anymore. They are builders now, and they know how to solve problems on purpose.
Keep Going. This is just the beginning. AJ, Nia, and Malik keep building, stay curious, help others, and level up. They already have the skills, so now it is time to use them.
